scientific_question: Does self-training at the compact virtual weight V=C+R_hat close the stable Pair-VQ functional-path loss gap while preserving the existing compact state contract?

frozen_mechanism.persistent_compact_base: C is represented by the existing pair-VQ codebooks, codes, and fast residual state.
frozen_mechanism.persistent_compact_residual: R_hat is represented by the already qualified fractional_lattice_q7q8_b32_p25_rq4_cfcq5b64l16 feedback codec in optimizer state.
frozen_mechanism.transient_forward_weight: The nonpersistent materialized module weight is always V=C+R_hat and forward/backward differentiates at V.
optimizer_transition: Start from transient V_t and its task gradient g(V_t).
Apply the existing compact-momentum Muon request and weight decay to V_t, producing requested virtual target T_t.
Project T_t once into pair-VQ base C_(t+1); do not add the old feedback residual to T_t because V_t already contains it.
Encode R_(t+1)=T_t-C_(t+1) with the existing B64/L16 compact feedback codec.
Materialize the next transient forward weight V_(t+1)=C_(t+1)+decode(R_(t+1)).
frozen_mechanism.initialization: R_hat is zero before the first optimizer step, so V_0=C_0.
frozen_mechanism.resume: After loading module codes and optimizer feedback state, reconstruct transient V before the next forward pass.
forbidden_variants: adding old feedback to a request formed from V, which would double count carry
using a dense master weight, dense momentum, or dense ambient residual
changing codec, bits, FHT block, LR, schedule, seed, or attention parent

state_and_compute_contract.compact_checkpoint_components: pair-VQ base plus existing B64/L16 residual codec

frozen_protocol.model: 124M, QK-only BlockFHT attention parent, full MLP Pair-VQ replacement

focused_tests: forward uses C+R_hat after the first optimizer step
the request is based on V and old feedback is not added twice
post-step transient weight equals decoded compact base plus decoded compact feedback
checkpoint resume reconstructs exactly the pre-save virtual weight
legacy non-forward-visible Pair-VQ behavior remains unchanged

decision_rule.preflight_pass: Authorize exactly one 238-update endpoint with a terminal/error-only @Codex watchdog.
decision_rule.endpoint_pass: Seal the 124M compact full-MLP closure. A longer horizon or larger rung requires a new theory and transfer preregistration; no automatic scale-up.
decision_rule.endpoint_fail: Localize whether the failure is virtual-state reconstruction drift or remaining self-path optimization mismatch. Do not sweep LR, bits, codec, FHT, width, or horizon.
